mapper.select: SELECT CONCAT('',d.version) version,d.status,d.reviewed_at FROM consultation_doctor d JOIN user_account u ON u.id=d.user_id AND u.is_deleted=0 AND u.account_status=1 LEFT JOIN consultation_doctor_review_read r ON r.user_id=d.user_id AND r.review_version>=d.version WHERE d.user_id=#{user} AND d.status IN ('APPROVED','REJECTED','DISABLED') AND d.reviewed_at IS NOT NULL AND r.user_id IS NULL

SELECT c.id consultation_id,c.title, CASE WHEN c.patient_id=#{user} THEN COALESCE(d.real_name,'接诊医生') WHEN c.anonymous=1 THEN '匿名糖友' ELSE COALESCE((SELECT p.nickname FROM user_profile p WHERE p.user_id=c.patient_id AND p.is_deleted=0),'患者') END peer_name, MAX(m.id) last_message_id,COUNT(*) unread_count
GROUP BY c.id,c.title,c.patient_id,c.anonymous,d.real_name ORDER BY last_message_id DESC,c.id DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM community_notification WHERE recipient_id = #{viewer} AND id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE community_notification SET read_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE recipient_id = #{viewer} AND id = #{id} AND read_at IS NULL
